thread:
sam: Heads-up — onboarding sampleapp hit a weird embed+rerank mismatch when running against the latest SDKs.

maria: Ugh, what mismatch? dims? response fields?

sam: Dims + padding behavior. Python SDK returns 768-d vectors, JS sampleapp ended up with 1536 vectors (double). Rerank endpoint then choked because it expects shape [n,768].

alex: Did the batching helper split or concat? We saw duplication before when helpers flattened arrays.

sam: From traces it looks like our embed-batcher toggles a pad-and-concat path when batch size=1 and pad=true. The sampleapp got a padded array twice instead of returning a single vector.

lee: Also saw auth retry noise in the logs — token refresh caused a duplicate request that the batcher merged incorrectly. Repro steps below.

sam: Repro (minimal):
```
# node sampleapp
POST /v1/embeddings -> batcher.pad=true -> returns [ [v1], [pad] ]
POST /v1/embeddings retry on 401 -> batcher merges -> final output length = 2*v1.length
```

maria: That explains the 1536 length. SDK parity issue: python client uses pad=false by default, js used pad=true historically. We should harmonize defaults.

alex: Agreed. Proposal: change js default to pad=false and add explicit arguments in quickstart sample. Also add an assert in rerank client: if any vector length != model_dim -> raise clear error.

lee: For immediate triage, you can add a quick validation hook in the sampleapp: `if (vec.length !== expected) { log and drop request }` — avoids failing rerank path.

sam: I'll push a tiny PR for sampleapp change + a note in onboarding guide. Want to also flag the retry->merge behavior as dangerous.

alex: Filing a devex bug: `DX-embed-merge-on-retry` with steps and logs. Assigning to eng-runtime to decide if batcher or auth retry should change.

embed-bot: deploy-notification: canary build for sampleapp updated (build 2026-03-01T10:12:00Z). :rocket:

maria: Two follow-ups: (1) add an SDK parity test that compares vector dims across python/js/go for the same prompt, (2) add a small lint in the CLI that warns when pad=true and model_dim != detected_dim.

lee: Also add a short note in the quickstart: "If you see doubled dims, check SDK pad setting and transient auth retries."

sam: I'll include a tiny log excerpt in the bug report. Example error returned by rerank service: `400 BadRequest: expected vectors shape (n,768) got (n,1536)` — that's the message we should surface to users earlier.

alex: Sounds good. I'll review the PR. Thanks for catching this, sam. :thumbsup:

maria: One more: might be good to add a small end-to-end sample in our tests that runs embeddings -> rerank on a mocked endpoint to prevent regressions.

sam: Added to bug. Closing out with action items: 1) sampleapp PR to set pad=false and add validation, 2) devex test for parity, 3) eng-runtime to consider retry-merging fix.

lee: Tagging @eng-runtime in the bug.

sam: Thanks all.
